svg.title: How the six roles work together
svg.desc: A person, at the top, sets the goals, limits and budgets and decides at named checkpoints: decisions go down to the AI coordinator and evidence comes back up. The coordinator, the AI workers and the reviewers work inside the Runtime Pack, the versioned procedures, policies, templates and checks that govern them: the coordinator follows those procedures, the workers and reviewers work from the scoped briefs it gives them, and the pack launches nothing. The coordinator sends each AI worker a brief and gets a report back, and sends the claims to independent reviewers, who challenge them and send findings back. Below, the coordinator reads and writes the project record: decisions, evidence, findings and progress, in files and Git.
